sloka: श्रुत्वा प्राप्तान्मुनींस्तांस्तु बालसूर्यसमप्रभान् ।प्रत्युवाच ततो द्वास्स्थं प्रवेशय यथासुखम् ।। ७.१.१२ ॥
transliteration: śrutvā prāptānmunīṁstāṁstu bālasūryasamaprabhān ।pratyuvāca tato dvāssthaṁ praveśaya yathāsukham ।। 7.1.12 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that those sages, radiant like the morning sun, had arrived, Rama then replied to the doorkeeper, instructing him to admit them comfortably.
